decisions.what: Replaced transition-transform/transition-colors with transition-all duration-200 on CTA buttons
decisions.why: Avoids duplicate/conflicting transition utilities while enabling the full set of morphing interaction classes

decisions.what: Added hover:scale-105 active:scale-98 hover:shadow-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-offset-2 cursor-pointer to all four CTAs
decisions.why: Specified in the code change description for premium micro-interaction feedback on all CTA elements

decisions.what: Added hover:bg-gray-50 only to the hero CTA (white button)
decisions.why: Spec explicitly targets the white hero button for this specific hover color enhancement

decisions.what: Did not add type='button' to anchor tag CTAs
decisions.why: type attribute is not valid on anchor elements; the subscribe button already has type='submit'
